summary: Resolve native prompt attention locators from exact accepted diagnostic answer actors

replay.detail: Read-only helper binds the native-prompt-answer operation, source subject and original episode evidence.

schema.detail: No tables or indexes added. Main approved claims_operation_index lookup under fractal_store::store::attention_prompt_resolution: exact operation, 1 MiB JSON parse cap, scalar-only output bounded to 4096-byte identity and 40-byte timestamp. Source-site inventory lv-h7f62645b6f58 records the dynamic query sink.

rules.detail: Authorizes only the person addressed at accepted native answer admission, or admitted delegated acted_for person with matching delegation episode; preserves the actual actor. Never reads current ownership.

compatibility.detail: No wire changes. Native diagnostics have seven-day retention: missing receipts return None, never imply resolution. Durable harness-question.resolved compact receipts have actor/key digests and no attributable person, so cannot prove actor identity. Parent integrates SourceResolution, registry and endpoint dispatch.

recovery.detail: Read-only change; rollback does not change stored claims.
